caller-controlled-sizes.reason: no size or count is caller-controlled here; the step surface has no limit and a caller bounds its own playouts

count-semantics.reason: the counts that make a gammon belong to Outcome.ResultOf, which this change does not touch

empty-collections.reason: no collection is read; the value is found from a finished position

exact-min-max.reason: the thresholds of a gammon and a backgammon belong to Outcome.ResultOf, which this change does not touch

exception-leakage.reason: Legal paths never throw: every game in the equivalence and terminal tests runs to its end. A bad argument (null, a face no die shows, a play not offered, an index out of range) throws ArgumentException, ArgumentOutOfRangeException or ArgumentNullException by design, as Opening, DiceThrow and Movement already do for programmer errors; it is never a rules decline.

exclusive-or.reason: the exclusive choice between results belongs to Outcome.ResultOf, which this change does not touch

integer-extremes.reason: the entry takes positions and players through the step surface, with no integer a caller chooses

missing-content-masking.reason: the step surface reads no optional content, so nothing can be missing and mask a decline

overflow-underflow.reason: the entry reads counts of men and does no arithmetic on a caller value

refusal-classification.reason: the terminal decision passes Outcome.ResultOf through unchanged, so any decline keeps its own classification; no game reaches one under ruleset 6

sentinel-wraparound.reason: no counter, index or wraparound value reaches this entry; the only index offered is bounds-checked elsewhere
